newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan down slightly against US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan down slightly against US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed slightly down at 8.2938 on Thursday from Monday's 8.2935 against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai due to a technical correction, traders said.
The yuan opened little changed at 8.2936 and consolidated between 8.2935 and 8.2940, hitting an intraday high of 8.2932 and a sudden intraday low of 8.2969.
Trading was less active than Wednesday with most done at 8.2937, traders said.
Dealers said buying power weakened after the yuan hit consecutive 20-month highs in the past two days, but strong pro-yuan sentiment in the market continued to support its trend.
One dealer said the yuan consolidated above 8.2940 after continuing to set new highs this week.
"As the yuan had moved higher, some traders stood on the sidelines to avoid risk," he said
Although the currency fell suddenly during trading and closed lower on Thursday, strong pro-yuan sentiment was not dampened, another trader said.
He said he expected the yuan to crawl up steadily on Friday.
The yuan closed up slightly at an intraday high of 6.7905 from 6.8001 against 100 Japanese yen and unchanged at 1.0710 against the Hong Kong dollar.
